layman_headline: Fear is gripping the market and none of the swing candidates are compelling enough to risk capital right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful state with the Fear and Greed Index at 27, trending worse over the past week. Bitcoin is essentially flat, treading water around $64,400. The swing trade candidates available are mostly obscure, low-liquidity tokens that either just pumped hard (BTW up 87%, PUMP up 38%) making them risky to chase, or are in deep decline from all-time highs with no chart data or RSI readings to properly evaluate. There is no clear, high-conviction setup worth entering.
layman_action: Stay patient and keep cash ready. The market mood is negative and the available opportunities are too risky or too poorly supported by data to justify a new position. Wait for fear to stabilize or reverse, and for a quality setup with proper technical confirmation.
